name: False Prayer
disable: DC 43 Deception check (master) to falsely proclaim the party's devotion to Ydersius, DC 41 Religion check (master) to rededicate the statue to Yig, or DC 38 Thievery check (expert) twice to pry the statue's eyes from their sockets
reset: Unless the statue is destroyed, both its eyes are removed, or the statue is rededicated to Yig, the hazard deactivates and resets 1 minute after no living creatures are in the room.
routine: (2 actions) The statue uses each of its two actions to cast a 9th-rank Blazing Bolt spell (DC 41), targeting up to three living creatures per casting. For each eye removed from the statue, the hazard has 1 fewer action. Until the beginning of the statue's next turn, the doors to area H17 don't require an Athletics check to Force Open (but opening them still requires an Interact action).

items.name: Divine Command
items.text:
Trigger A creature moves adjacent to the doors to area H17 or attempts to disable the hazard and fails

---
Effect The light from the statue's eyes intensifies. The statue casts Overwhelming Presence (DC 41 Will save), targeting each living creature in the room. The hazard then rolls initiative.

text: A statue dedicated to Ydersius fills the chamber with the divine glory of the Father of Serpents.
